sentences.t1: The train leaves at nine. I bought a ticket, and then I found a seat by the window.
sentences.t2: I cleaned the windows today. It took most of the morning, but the light is better now.
sentences.t3: Our neighbour painted the fence. It is green now, and it looks much newer.
sentences.t4: I walked to the post office. The line was short, so I was back before lunch.
sentences.t5: The library opens at ten. I returned two books, and I borrowed a new one.
sentences.t6: We planted tomatoes last spring. They grew well, and we had enough for the whole summer.
sentences.t7: The meeting moved to Thursday. I changed my calendar, and I sent a note to the team.
sentences.t8: I made soup for dinner. It needed more salt, so I added some at the table.
